description: Inspect live Google Search Console sitemap and per-URL indexing status for a domain or URL.

inspectUrls.description: Check individual sitemap URLs via Google URL Inspection API (default true).

maxInspectUrls.description: Max sitemap URLs to inspect per call (default 35, max 50).

url.description: Domain or https:// URL to inspect in Google Search Console.

name: launchfiles_seo_indexing_status
